BiblicalUsage: All the fugitives of Zedekiah's house shall fall by the sword, and those who remain shall be scattered toward all winds. The word is the refugee, the one who flees, and Ezekiel says the flight will not save them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fugitive's fate is the last word on running from God: the sword finds those who flee, and the winds scatter those who remain, because there is no refuge outside His word.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
